surface_mechanism_description: The light-induced wettability change is based on changing the surface functionality by light excitation at the bandgap of the semiconducting oxides. Photoinduced wettability change of TiO2 and ZnO is typically realized on single crystals or on polycrystalline oxides, not on amorphous oxides.
